newsitem.title: MEXICO: GFB seeks 36.19 pct of warehousing unit.
newsitem.headline: GFB seeks 36.19 pct of warehousing unit.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Bancomer, Mexico's second largest banking group, said it will issue 39,651,267 L shares which it plans to use to buy an outstanding 36.19 percent of its warehousing unit, Almacenadora Bancomer.

In information released to the Mexican Stock Exchange, the group said it had approval from shareholders to raise the capital. But it urged them not to exercise their right to the shares to enable it to buy part of the warehousing division that it does not already own.
Those shareholders who want the L shares, however, are able to buy them at a price of 2.83 pesos per share, and the rate of one L share per 152 A, B and L shares that they already hold.
Shareholders had a period of 15 days from Dec. 12 to make their purchases.
